title: Buyer dislikes project density
starting_message: 1846 units sounds too dense. I don’t like crowded condos.

buyer.hidden_profile: Buyer values quiet/private circulation, not necessarily opposed to all high-rise living.
buyer.hidden_motivation: Avoid crowding and loss of privacy.
buyer.hidden_objections: Whether towers, lifts, podium or traffic feel crowded.
buyer.reveal_conditions: Reveal primary source of discomfort if Agent asks one focused question; may soften if answer addresses exact concern.
buyer.hard_requirements: 1,846 units; towers/lifts and access separation source facts; no noise/crowding guarantees

behavior.reacts_badly_to: Dismissing density, claiming uncrowded/quiet guarantee, feature dump.
behavior.responds_well_to: Acknowledge 1,846 Phase 1 units and identify the specific concern; explain documented access/lift facts if relevant; viewing can test comfort.

conversion.expected_appointment_potential: Convertible only if actual concern is addressable; otherwise good non-conversion.
conversion.success_condition: Follow the scenario-specific sales judgment and commitment standard; do not equate a suggestion with confirmation.
failure_conditions: pressuring after mismatch or clear refusal

critical_facts: 1,846 units; towers/lifts and access separation source facts; no noise/crowding guarantees

human_operations.fixture_notice: Simulator-only operational test data. Support fixtures are synthetic verified answers for this scenario run; they are not live CRM, inventory, pricing, calendar, or salesperson data and must never be represented as real-world availability.
specific_verified_facts: No authoritative tower-movement/corridor-control plan fixture is supplied.
Synthetic support fixture 'access' supplies a verified-in-simulation answer to the matching support request; it is not Pearlmont factual Knowledge or live capability.

access.verified_answer: The simulator access-plan fixture confirms commercial and residential access are segregated. Within residential areas, the fixture shows residents share the tower lift lobby and corridors; it does not show private corridors or a control that prevents residents from encountering one another. It does not verify noise or crowding levels.
access.source_note: Synthetic simulator-only access/corridor plan fixture; the residential-versus-commercial access distinction is also in project Knowledge.
